summary: Tested all 5 requested FozPay changes (deposit amount fix, auto-convert-from-USDT, per-currency+network withdrawal fee matrix, explorer_url on tx, user balance_usdt) end-to-end via backend pytest (14/14 passing) and Playwright frontend flow. All backend endpoints returned expected shape (matrix has 16 rows, PUT persists BNB:4 override, checkout amount_to_pay==amount, auto-convert branch triggers only for EVM, admin users list carries balance_usdt, transactions include explorer_url key). Frontend Settings->Платформа renders full withdrawal fee matrix with data-testids pf-wd-row-BNB:4 / pf-wd-cab-BNB:4 / pf-wd-api-BNB:4 / pf-save; saving shows success toast 'Комісії платформи оновлено'. Користувачі tab renders 'Баланс: $0.00 (за курсом USDT)' via data-testid user-balance-{id}. Wallet page loads with transactions table.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is large; consider splitting withdraw() + withdrawal_worker() into a dedicated module for maintainability.
Standardized envelope {status, data} used consistently — good; ensure frontend axios interceptors unwrap 'data' uniformly (they appear to).
explorer_url is stored per transaction — good; make sure txid backfill after on-chain confirmation also rewrites explorer_url when previously null.
seed_data_creation: Created a couple of TEST_ invoices via POST /api/invoices during testing; no cleanup needed (invoice-only, zero funds).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API envelope is {status, data} — always unwrap .data. Admin login works. All balances are zero (real HD wallet), so on-chain deposit/withdrawal cannot be verified end-to-end in this env; only branching logic and DB records were validated. Withdraw auto-convert branch returns HTTP 400 with a Ukrainian detail mentioning USDT for EVM currencies and plain 'Недостатньо коштів' for BTC — this is intentional.
